name: Cheech & Chong - Singles - Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Tempest White (H)
description:
One joint, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Tempest White single is a cryo-infused pre-roll packed with quality flower and infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light it and go.

Tempest White brings a crisp, clean profile: bright citrus and soft floral notes up front, cut with a cool, subtly minty edge and a smooth, earthy finish. Blended with a hybrid terpene profile for a balanced, easygoing feel — clear-headed and mellow, comfortable at any hour.

Why you'll love it:

Cryo-infused pre-roll — quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Tempest White flavor — bright citrus and florals with a cool, earthy finish
Hybrid effects — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every joint. Cheech & Chong Tempest White is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
